scope: Original concise Dancer level-75 supplement. Historical facts and acquisition routes, not proof of installed Zenith quest completion.

articles.title: Lakeside Minuet
articles.intro: Unlock Dancer. Start with any main job at level 30 or higher.
articles.body_html:
Requirements

Level 30+, Wings of the Goddess access, and a route into Jugner Forest (S). No item purchase is required.

Steps

  1. Speak to Laila at the dancer group in Upper Jeuno (G-7). Choose “I surely do.”, then “Never!” to accept.
  2. Speak to Rhea Myuliah beside Laila.
  3. Visit Valderotaux inside Lion Springs Tavern, Southern San d'Oria (K-6), and complete the dance conversation.
  4. Return to Rhea Myuliah in Upper Jeuno.
  5. Enter Jugner Forest (S) and examine Glowing Pebbles by Lake Mechieume (I-5). Receive the Stardust Pebble key item. The target name matters; the ground need not visibly glow.
  6. Return to Laila in Upper Jeuno to unlock Dancer.

Reward

Dancer becomes selectable at your Mog House. Title: Troupe Brilioth Dancer.

articles.title: The Unfinished Waltz
articles.intro: Dancer artifact weapon quest: obtain War Hoop.
articles.body_html:
Requirements

Dancer level 40+; Lakeside Minuet completed. Remain on Dancer for the Grauberg events and fight.

Steps

  1. Talk to Laila, then Rhea Myuliah, in Upper Jeuno (G-7).
  2. Travel to Grauberg (S) and find the ??? among three close trees in Witchfire Glen (F-5). Use the past zone, not Abyssea.
  3. Examine ??? for the scene, then examine it again without leaving the zone to spawn Migratory Hippogryph. Defeat it.
  4. Examine ??? again to receive The Essence of Dance.
  5. Open your permanent key-item list and read The Essence of Dance.
  6. Speak to Laila as Dancer to receive War Hoop.

Next

Change zones and wait until the next Vana’diel day before starting The Road to Divadom.

Zenith availability: this is the original quest route. Completion on the current Zenith server has not been confirmed; a wiki entry does not install the quest.

articles.title: The Road to Divadom
articles.intro: Obtain Dancer's Tights and open the three commissioned artifact pieces.
articles.body_html:
Requirements

Dancer level 50+; The Unfinished Waltz completed; zone and next Vana’diel day after completion. Bring one Yagudo Glue.

Steps

  1. Talk to Laila in Upper Jeuno (G-7) as Dancer.
  2. Enter Jugner Forest (S) for a scene. Stay on Dancer.
  3. Examine Glowing Pebbles at Lake Mechieume (I-5).
  4. Trade one Yagudo Glue to Glowing Pebbles.
  5. Return to Laila as Dancer for Dancer's Tights.
  6. Talk to Olgald beside the dancers to open Matthias commissions for the tiara, bangles and shoes.

Next

After zoning and the next Vana’diel day, start Comeback Queen.

Zenith availability: this is the original quest route. Completion on the current Zenith server has not been confirmed; a wiki entry does not install the quest.

articles.title: Comeback Queen
articles.intro: Win the dance performance to receive Dancer's Casaque.
articles.body_html:
Requirements

Dancer level 50+; The Road to Divadom completed; change zones and wait for the next Vana’diel day.

Steps

  1. Speak to Laila in Upper Jeuno (G-7) as Dancer to obtain Wyatt’s Proposal.
  2. Take the proposal to Harmodios inside the music shop in Bastok Markets (K-10).
  3. Return to Laila, then talk to Rhea Myuliah to practice the audience minigame.
  4. After the next Vana’diel day, speak to Laila for the real performance. Choose dances promptly: children favor Jigs, young adults favor Waltzes, older adults favor Sambas.
  5. Keep at least four of seven spectators watching your troupe. Alternating Jigs and Waltzes targets the five children/young adults. Continue responding until the scene ends.
  6. Win to receive Dancer's Casaque. If you lose, zone and wait until the next Vana’diel day to retry.

Zenith availability: this is the original quest route. Completion on the current Zenith server has not been confirmed; a wiki entry does not install the quest.

articles.title: Matthias
articles.intro: Crafts three pieces of Dancer artifact armor in Bastok Markets.
articles.body_html:
Unlock the service

Finish The Road to Divadom, then speak to Olgald in Upper Jeuno (G-7). Keep Dancer as your main job when speaking to Olgald and using Matthias’s service.

What to bring

RewardLevelTrade one of each
Dancer's Bangles52Karakul Cloth, Rainbow Cloth, Rainbow Velvet
Dancer's Tiara54Imperial Silk Cloth, Silver Brocade, Wolf Felt
Dancer's Toe Shoes56Wamoura Cloth, Moblinweave, Gold Brocade

Steps

  1. Find Matthias on the bridge near the music shop in Bastok Markets (J-9).
  2. Choose one armor piece. Trade all three listed materials for that piece.
  3. Change zones and return after the next Vana’diel day to collect it.
  4. Order the next piece after collection. Only one order can be active, and a chosen order cannot be cancelled.

These are material commissions, not treasure-coffer drops.

Zenith availability: this is the original quest route. Completion on the current Zenith server has not been confirmed; a wiki entry does not install the quest.

articles.title: A Furious Finale
articles.intro: Original Dancer route for raising the level limit from 70 to 75.
articles.body_html:
Requirements

Dancer level 66+, the prior level-limit quest completed, and Comeback Queen completed. Zone and wait until the next Vana’diel day.

Steps

  1. Talk to Laila in Upper Jeuno (G-7) on Dancer.
  2. Obtain Dancer's Testimony. Verified examples are Amber Quadav in North Gustaberg (S) and Young Quadav in Grauberg (S).
  3. Trade the testimony to Laila and accept her challenge to travel to Qu'Bia Arena.
  4. Trade the testimony to the Burning Circle. Defeat Laila within the ten-minute battle. Preserve TP for healing; use Quickstep to help land hits.
  5. After the victory, complete the exit scene and check the raised limit.

Do not repeat a level-limit unlock already cleared on another job. Follow Zenith’s current limit-break page if a custom progression route is installed. Retail Rhapsody-based Trust access is outside this 75-era route.

Zenith availability: this is the original quest route. Completion on the current Zenith server has not been confirmed; a wiki entry does not install the quest.

articles.title: Dancer Artifact and Relic Upgrades
articles.intro: One place for the Dancer armor upgrade hand-ins.
articles.body_html:
Before starting

Unlock Sea by reaching Garden of Antiquity in Chains of Promathia. Visit Sagheera in Port Jeuno (I-8).

Artifact +1: level 74

Each recipe needs its matching base AF piece, one Filet Lace, one Gold Stud, the crafted material and the listed coins.

RewardCrafted materialAncient Beastcoins
Dancer's Tiara +1Gold Ingot30
Dancer's Casaque +1Scarlet Linen35
Dancer's Bangles +1Gold Ingot25
Dancer's Tights +1Silky Suede25
Dancer's Toe Shoes +1Silky Suede20
  1. Collect the armor and materials. Filet Lace comes from Temenos; Gold Stud from Apollyon. Ancient Beastcoins are Limbus currency.
  2. Trade the required Ancient Beastcoins to Sagheera first to add them to your stored balance.
  3. Trade the base piece, Filet Lace, Gold Stud and crafted material together. Sagheera deducts the recipe’s coins.
  4. Return after the next Vana’diel midnight and collect the finished piece before placing another order.

Relic +1: level 75

Trade the base relic piece, its matching -1 item, the material below and 30 Ordelle Bronzepiece together. Collect after the next Vana’diel midnight.

Reward-1 drop zoneCrafted material
Etoile Tiara +1Dynamis - ValkurmGold Ingot
Etoile Casaque +1Dynamis - TavnaziaCilice
Etoile Bangles +1Dynamis - BuburimuGold Ingot
Etoile Tights +1Dynamis - TavnaziaSmooth Velvet
Etoile Toe Shoes +1Dynamis - QufimHoly Leather

These hand-in recipes and the next-midnight collection rule are present in the reviewed server base. Exact Limbus and Dynamis loot availability still follows Zenith’s installed content.

Use

articles.title: Dancer
articles.intro: A melee support job that uses TP for healing, travel dances and party support, with Steps and Finishing Moves for control.
articles.body_html:
Start here

Unlock with Lakeside Minuet. Build TP through melee attacks, use Steps for Finishing Moves, and reserve enough TP to heal. Reverse Flourish converts those moves back into TP.

Abilities and dances through level 75

LevelAbilityFamilyPractical use
1TranceSpecialTemporarily removes TP costs from dances. Use it when repeated healing would otherwise empty your TP.
5Drain SambaSambaApply the samba to yourself, then hit the enemy to inflict a drain daze. Party melee attacks against that enemy can drain HP.
15Curing WaltzWaltzSpend TP to heal one eligible target.
20QuickstepStepSpend TP on a melee-range step that lowers evasion when it lands and earns Finishing Moves.
20Animated FlourishFlourish ISpend Finishing Moves to draw enemy attention.
25Aspir SambaSambaHit an MP-bearing enemy to give party melee attacks an MP-drain effect against it.
25Divine WaltzWaltzSpend TP to heal nearby party members around the target.
25Spectral JigJigGive yourself Sneak and Invisible for travel. Cancel existing Sneak before refreshing it.
30Curing Waltz IIWaltzA stronger single-target heal that spends more TP than Curing Waltz.
30Box StepStepA successful step lowers defense and earns Finishing Moves.
30Desperate FlourishFlourish ISpend Finishing Moves on an attack that can inflict Weight.
35Drain Samba IISambaA stronger HP-drain samba for attacks against an enemy you have struck.
35Healing WaltzWaltzSpend TP to remove an eligible harmful status from a target. It does not remove every status.
40Stutter StepStepA successful step lowers magic evasion and earns Finishing Moves.
40Reverse FlourishFlourish IIConvert stored Finishing Moves into TP. More stored moves produce more TP.
45Curing Waltz IIIWaltzA stronger single-target TP heal.
45Haste SambaSambaStrike the enemy to let party melee attacks against it receive the samba haste effect.
45Violent FlourishFlourish ISpend Finishing Moves on an attack that can Stun. A hit does not guarantee that Stun lands.
50Building FlourishFlourish IISpend Finishing Moves to improve the next weapon skill. Save it for a weapon skill you can use promptly.
55Chocobo JigJigIncrease your own movement speed. This is the level-55 single-target jig.
60Aspir Samba IISambaA stronger MP-drain samba; the enemy must have MP.
60Wild FlourishFlourish IISpend Finishing Moves to prepare the target for a skillchain. Follow with a compatible weapon skill.
65Drain Samba IIISambaThe strongest Drain Samba available in the level-75 era.
70Curing Waltz IVWaltzThe strongest single-target Curing Waltz available by level 75.
75Saber DanceMerit abilityIncrease Double Attack while disabling Waltzes. Cancel the stance before emergency Waltz healing.
75Fan DanceMerit abilityReduce physical damage while disabling Sambas. Choose it when you need to survive incoming hits.
75No Foot RiseMerit abilityGenerate Finishing Moves without landing a Step. Requires Group 2 merits.

Weapons and weapon skills

Use Dagger as your main weapon family. Cloak and Dagger unlocks Evisceration at job level 71+ and base dagger skill 230+. Unlocking a Myth (Dancer) uses Main Gauche to unlock Pyrrhic Kleos at 75.

The original level-75 Dancer special weapon is the Mythic dagger Terpsichore. Dancer cannot equip Mandau in the original rules; do not follow a Thief relic route expecting a Dancer weapon.
